finding: A query cancelled after terminal checkpoint but before terminal publication could still have finish(Ok) return success, even though later receipt checks prevented complete delivery.
fix: Use a fixed empty-slot publication with the same lifecycle lock as cancellation. On rejection the unowned sender publishes the exact failure terminal; an owned producer retains the lease to publish its explicit error terminal.

red.observation: Cancellation completed before publication, but finish returned Ok.

terminal_regression.note: Includes both new query tests; do not add them again as distinct tests.

early_runs: green and producer records predate the additional session test and are retained as history.
limitations: Controlled in-process interleavings, not exhaustive concurrency, IPC, cross-platform, RSS or performance qualification. Deadline is an instantaneous admission check. No user callback is executed while locked; empty slot is checked before the lock and a rejected item is returned.
